selectionRule.withinAMove: the first family, in the declared order, with a searched point that passes the move's within clause lands the move, at its point with the smallest move objective
selectionRule.atTheJointPoint: between candidates, the smaller selection metric lands: the median |log(web / native)| over F u C u P, 2x WebGPU light, gate partition (t1.selection_metric)
selectionRule.tie: two metrics within the selection tie of each other (the median over the same cells of log(1 + bar / native), t1.selection_tie) tie, and the tie goes to the fewer moved leaves

landingRule.scope: the final stage, WebGPU, 2x light, both poses, F u T u C u P less the referees, from T1's three outputs (t1.landing); a T cell's fidelity and change on T1-fine, its away on T1-low
landingRule.fullClose: every F cell within (no T cell is required within); no cell away with g > B (a T cell's on T1-low); no cell overshoot (a T cell's on T1-fine); every other adopted row passing or its miss named; the twelve referees within at the exposure. Lands.
landingRule.improvement: the F aggregate (median |log((k + eps) / (n + eps))|) at most half of c05's; no cell away with g > B (a T cell's on T1-low); no cell overshoot (a T cell's on T1-fine); every referee within or an unchanged miss; every other adopted row passing or its miss named. Lands as improved, every F cell not within named.
landingRule.regressionBudget: a C or P cell that is a miss on c05 and unchanged stays a named miss; one away with g <= B is a named regression inside the budget; one with g > B fails the landing; M2 keeps its own 0.02 reference-relative tolerance as a regression stop; a T cell's budget reads T1-low's error growth (away with g <= B a named regression, g > B a failure)
landingRule.cssTier: a residual: its T1 outputs recorded; its tables pass or are named; a CSS row away beyond its table bound is a named tier residual
landingRule.unmeasured: a member of the scope with no reading makes the verdict UNMEASURED, never a landing
landingRule.otherwise: the wave closes at the finding: no document sealed, T1 lands in the owner test (X51)

permittedChanges: remove a leaf (or a family whose every leaf is struck) that its ladder struck, citing the ladder by id
replace C's `inert` PENDING with the L3 citation once L3 proves the 1x byte identity (the value stays 0), or remove family C when L3 does not
narrow a grid to the subset inside its ladder's non-flat range, citing the ladder by id

textStratum.fine: T1-fine: the SD of L - G(L, sigma 4 device px), linear luminance, over the native silhouette eroded 4 CSS px
textStratum.low: T1-low: the SD of G(L, sigma 4 device px) over the same support
textStratum.outputs: T1's three outputs per cell on each band, at the cell's own bar and code (the seven runs are pixel-identical, so every statistic's separation is 0 and the bar is 0.5 code)
textStratum.t1: recorded on every T cell, read by no clause
textStratum.fullClose: does not require a T cell within
textStratum.selection: T is outside F u C u P: the selection metric and every move objective do not read it
textStratum.implementation: packages/calibration/results/2026-10-03-w44-g1-refit/cuts/t1.py and readings.py, pinned below with test_t1.py
textStratum.why: T1 reads the hc-text-7 cells under (0.79-0.89 on c05) while the fine band reads them x1.9-8.5 over, and every lever that removes fine structure takes T1 further under (charter Decision Log 7 item 3)

candidateIdentity: a candidate's dark endpoints are patch- and digest-identical to c05's dark documents, and its light endpoints are c05's on every leaf but the declared 2x leaves of the moves (and, in the receded light document, sizeHeavySecondShare), so its 1x-reaching leaves are c05's; a candidate carries the glass0.250 key because candidate mode refuses a shipped key, so the identity is patch-and-digest, and byte identity is the sealed documents' at the freeze (charter clause 5; Decision Log 7 item 5)
